parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to 5 minutes ago.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to now. Max duration is 1 hour.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description:
Optional. Restrict edges to those originating from services
tagged with this environment (e.g. `production`, `staging`).
Targets need not be environment-tagged. Omit to disable the
filter.
